findings: Callback-free Atom1 native export and import succeeds with0trailingbytes.
Finite field registration after its count produces exportOk but native importUnexpectedEof.
Polynomial-list registration after its count produces exportOk but native importInvalidData(legacyatomformat).
Each process exports/imports correctly once registration is complete.
cause: State::export_partial separately reads registry lengths and creates append-only iterators; it also discovers polynomial-list symbols before a later independent list traversal. State::export has the same count/iterator pattern.
proposed_owner_fix: Capture the symbol, finite-field and polynomial-variable-list registries coherently under the existing State read lock before any destination Write call. Use only captured counts/items and partial-export symbol closure. Release the lock before writing so legal reentrant writer callbacks cannot deadlock; preserve native wire layout.
